01

Shows on the board

02

Shows

In date order. Titles wrap and shrink to fit on their own; press return in a box to force a line break. Switching to fewer shows keeps the others saved for later.

03

Licensing block

Wraps automatically inside the safe area. Keep the arrangement wording exactly as the contract states it.

04

Sponsor logos

They sit above the PACA circle in one-color bone, three to a row. New logos are converted automatically; a dark logo on white or on a transparent background works best.

05

Export

Exports RGB at full 240 PPI. Lamar wants CMYK, so the file still needs a conversion to U.S. Web Coated (SWOP) v2, relative colorimetric with black point compensation.
